title: Golden Egg Fried Rice
summary: A fluffy, golden Chinese-style egg fried rice adapted for home cooking from Chef Lee Yeon-bok's golden fried rice technique.

steps.description: Thinly slice the scallion and dice the carrot and ham into 5mm pieces. Break up any clumps in the cooked rice.
Crack the eggs into a bowl and beat until smooth.
Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a skillet and stir-fry the scallion over medium heat for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the carrot and ham and stir-fry for 2 minutes, then move them to the edge of the skillet.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of oil. Pour in the beaten eggs and stir with chopsticks or a spatula until half-set.
Add the rice. Stir-fry over high heat for 2 to 3 minutes, mixing the eggs, vegetables and ham evenly and breaking up clumps with a spatula.
Season with salt, powdered chicken stock and black pepper. Stir-fry for 1 more minute, adjust seasoning and serve.
